preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must hold some BNB balance (from fees or liquidity)

exploit_hint: The contract inherits from Ownable but doesn't override the selfdestruct functionality. As the owner, call selfdestruct with the attacker's address as the beneficiary. This will destroy the contract and send all remaining BNB (from fees, liquidity, etc.) to the attacker. First ensure the contract has BNB balance by triggering fee collection through token transfers or waiting for swapAndLiquify to execute.
